_comment: WHAT THE HARNESS'S SCRIPTS NEED THAT THE CONTAINER MAY NOT HAVE, and how to get each. Read by `scripts/ensure-software.ts` (`bun run cat software:ensure`), which tries, in order: already present -> apt -> pip -> a pinned GitHub release asset (sha256 required). Owner, 2026-10-09: "update skills and tools on finding software" and "also add apt" -- an agent that meets a missing program installs it rather than routing around it (skill `finding-software`). One entry per thing a script CHECKS FOR, named the way the script names it; `usedBy` is the scripts that check, so `--for <script>` installs exactly what that script needs.

software.name: tesseract
software.why: OCR for scanned PDFs (the pdf-ocr+pdf-pages rung).

software.name: pdftoppm
software.why: Renders PDF pages to images for OCR.

software.name: pdftotext
software.why: The text-layer rung of pdf-extract's ladder.

software.name: pandoc
software.why: Converts an arXiv paper's own LaTeX sections to markdown with the mathematics kept as $...$. Without it the overlay keeps the raw LaTeX, which still carries the maths.

software.name: pymupdf
software.licence: AGPL-3.0 -- installed into the environment to RUN the tools, never vendored or imported by committed code that ships (see pdf-structure.py's licence note)
software.why: The PDF backend ingest-document probes with; without it every PDF's rung is `undetermined`.

software.name: beans
software.why: The work-plan CLI: the litlfred/beans fork of hmans/beans, which adds the `story` bean type (a Task here is a BPMN task; owner, 2026-10-16). `go install` cannot build the fork, so this release is the only route `install-beans.sh` uses. Built from litlfred/beans 47382ca; checksums from the release's beans_0.4.3-story.1_checksums.txt (measured 2026-10-16).
